steps.name: Clues to memory (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Rapidem] in “Monster Tree Mountain,” go to [Siam] through “The World Between Times.”

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Well, you came because you wanted to hear my story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After Asma, I heard this from Lapidem for the second time.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You may not know it, but spirits come and go according to a certain flow. It turns out that there are spirits who followed you here.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: After listening to the child's story, the Shinik of Tartarus felt that you were forgetting something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why didn't they talk about it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The spirit that followed you is annoying... The answer is,

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Shinik is like that. I probably didn't talk about it because it was annoying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As we talk, I have a question. I wonder if people are saying that I lost my memory when they see my expression... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You feel a great emptiness that you cannot understand. Wizards with strong magic or those with raw power will quickly realize this. That's why I told you the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying that the feeling of emptiness is caused by memory disappearing?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know what memories you've lost, though. Still, I think I can give you some help to recall your memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, thank you.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I didn't just get older. Do you by any chance know a man named Siam? I defeated the demon king with the goddess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, Siam… . Yes, I know.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Some stars in the night sky showed where he was. I tried to send the wind spirit there to hear the story, but it was in vain.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Although it certainly seems to be in our world, the area that is hidden is not something I can do anything about.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: In the past, Goddess Ceres said that memories remain when time and space are recognized together... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Maybe. Siam, where he is. I wonder if they know something about this place where time and space are warped... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I think I'll just have to go to where he is. In a space filled with emptiness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It is only natural to provide this much help to a person who has received an imprint of trust from the spirit. Then be careful. Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go.

steps.name: Clues to Memory (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ixion] in the “Room of Hell” and obtain the <Hero’s Gold Medal>. And report to [Siam].

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I couldn't really feel how much time had passed. Still, I feel like your energy has changed a lot, so I guess time has passed.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Could it be… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Iris Did you meet the sheep?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. We met. A lot has happened in the meantime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Siam what happened after what happened in Vanaheim until he met Iris.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (Siam seems unable to continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: After what happened in Vanaheim, I was very worried because I couldn't find Iris Yang's energy. Fortunately, I was in a temple filled with the power of a god, and I received the power of the goddess who stayed there... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I thought I was really happy to hear this news, but I'm still sad. It still seems like a harsh fate has followed Ms. Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Everything will be fine, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I guess something is going on since you came here to see me.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It's okay. Talk about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is said that the spirit Lapidem told him to go here, as well as the expression on his memory-less face.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: You are a grateful person. For recognizing me and sending you here... . I feel your emptiness too. I don't know what it is. but… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I know a way to awaken your memory, even if only in a small way.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Bring me the tools of one of the world's greatest wizards. The tool's thoughts will help you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Siam. Then I'll come back.

steps.name: Clues to memory (3)
steps.objective: Go to [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A great wizard's tool... . I can feel the energy left in my thoughts. It's not dangerous, so you don't have to stand so far away to watch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Then I'll take a closer look.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: This tool doesn't seem suited to fill your void. Still, it doesn't mean there were no results. I read your memory briefly.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: There was a girl in Tool who had a connection with a wizard who lost her memory, but luckily she seems to have found it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If it were that girl….)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Find out how from the girl. If you follow that method, you too may be able to find your lost memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, thank you! Thanks, it was helpful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If there is anyone I know who had a connection with that wizard...)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: And any time is good, so please give thanks to the spirits and say hello to Miss Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it. no. Iris Maybe you can say hello now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris, Iris. If you are listening, please let me know.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no response.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It's okay. It will take quite some time for Ms. Iris's message to be delivered here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Iris Yang would become a perfect goddess with great power... . It was nice to meet you. I hope only good things happen to you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Siam, see you next time. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (%s disappears and Siam grabs the wizard's tool to destroy it.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: … hmm? It's rare that someone else's memories remain.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It seems like someone else's memories remain in this tool... . An outsider who came to this world with a certain fate... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It seems like he comes from the same or similar world as me... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Why did a once righteous person become evil? .

steps.name: Clues to Memory (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Beskar] in “Gem Tree Forest” and obtain <Tears of Light>. Then report to [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There you are. I'm sure I told you to rest in Tartarus, but where have you been wandering around?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wait! It stinks. Sniff.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It looks like you've met a spirit and a wizard with rare powers? Still, it won't work for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's true that I met these two people, but I have no intention of fighting with Shinik. Instead, I want to ask you something.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What is it? If it's not fun, I won't budge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An expression that has lost its memory... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm sure you've lost your memory. Your stupid face says it all. An expression full of emptiness... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought it was just a joke.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't play around with that. Hehehe. Anyway, I just didn't pay attention because it was annoying.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So you want to know what memories you lost?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather than wanting to know what the memories are, I want you to tell me how to recover them.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm… .  It's a bit annoying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, as expected….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Still, it looks like fun, so I'll show you how. Because I owe you something.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When was it before? Oh, that's right. When I came to my senses during the Dark War, I found myself covered in blood with no memory.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Several villages were torn to pieces and I was almost called a devil. But I have to remember.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This is all because of that old man... . Anyway, I received help from the ancient dragon Gluart in the Gem Tree Forest.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I was able to find my memories using ‘tears of light’, which are called fruits of the jewel tree. But I don't know if I can still get it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Quantity is two. It won't work with just one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay. It will be fun so look forward to it♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh...what on earth should you expect?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Jewel Tree Forest is not easy to enter, but I managed to get there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik! I got the Tears of Light here!!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, good job. As expected, it is bright and beautiful then and now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Maybe if I had been a little late at that time, I wouldn't have even found a clue about the Tears of Light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: As soon as Ziscard became a superhuman, he cut down the ancient dragon Gluat. There was a pretext for defeating beings that were harmful to humans... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, no. Go and hear these stories for yourself. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think there's more to the story that I don't know.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a special item and will need purification. Otherwise, you'll get in trouble. Then wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shaynic holds the tear of light in his hand and closes his eyes. After a while, the jewel in his hand begins to shake as it resonates with Shinic's magic.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, that's it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eat♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eat, eat. Didn't you hear? Let me say it again. Swallow it♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Adventurer. If you just eat it, you will get sick. I have prepared water here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: After all, you are my butler♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Melvik, where did you come from?!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melbig.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A suspicious atmosphere is detected between Shinik and Melbig.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hold on!!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (As soon as Shinick's instructions are given, Melvik goes behind %s. Both hands are grabbed by Melvik and he tries to shake it off, but he can't escape easily.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Melvic… . What is it, you? Ugh, this power… . Aren't you a butler?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I am just an ordinary butler. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now, open your mouth and say ah.  Tears of light here. It has been purified to be edible, so you must eat it. Otherwise I will kill you♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, okay. I'll eat it. Just one for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A tear of light enters the mouth. Surprisingly, the texture is chewy and the unique scent spreads in the mouth, leaving a refreshing feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like... . Ah, this is not the time to be reviewing food. I need to eat another one right away. Gulp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I ate it, but why do I keep getting a headache? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The mind becomes blurred and then becomes clear again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this feeling... ?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I ended up with a bit of a headache. Thank goodness, I thought I was going to die at the time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The pain was as severe as the size of the memory. Still, it seems like the size of the memories you forgot wasn't that big. Still, forgotten memories aren't trivial.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Usually, there are many important memories that are artificially forgotten.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now, all that's left to do is realize it, right? This is my part. Let's get help from other superhumans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's it. Thank you, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm just paying back what I owed. I also want to see how far the goddess's motherfucker goes. Hehehe. It was fun, so that's it.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, Shinik is fun. Ah, how long has it been since I heard this? .(Excited)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvik, don't be happy about this. It's embarrassing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will go to my accommodation and rest. Please call me again when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, there's not much left, so look forward to it♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, God. Please don’t get your hopes up.)
